item.title: Missing Details Undermine Foldable Phone Coverage
item.description: Explore how sparse reporting on foldable smartphones—especially Apple’s rumored iPhone Duo—creates consumer confusion, hampers market growth, and challenges journalists.

item.title: Apple iPhone Duo: First Foldable iPhone Unveiled
item.description: Apple is set to launch its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, sparking debate on design, pricing, and competition with Samsung's foldables.

item.title: Samsung Greets Apple Foldables, Warns iPhone Duo Build
item.description: Samsung publicly applauds Apple’s entry into foldable phones, but warns the iPhone Duo and Ultra could outshine Samsung with superior build quality.

item.title: Apple Launches iPhone Duo: First Foldable iPhone
item.description: Apple's iPhone Duo brings a 5.4‑inch closed screen and a 7.6‑inch unfolded display, debuting Apple's foldable phone and reshaping the mobile market.

item.title: Apple’s Dual‑UTG Foldable Design Sets New Standard
item.description: Apple’s iPhone Ultra introduces a dual ultra‑thin glass stack to curb creasing, prompting Google, Oppo and Vivo to follow and Samsung to produce UTG.

item.title: Samsung Galaxy Unpacked July 22nd
item.description: Samsung announces Galaxy Unpacked for July 22nd with new foldables
